elements.name: two young men seen from behind side by side
taller young man in denim jacket
blue and white minibuses with headlights on

wrong_setting: The vehicles are large white full-size city buses rather than blue and white minibuses, and the generic high-rise street has nothing that places it on the edge of Addis Ababa.
anatomy: The two men are near-identical clones: same height, same dark jacket, same backpack and same stance.
notes: Repaint the second figure as a distinctly taller man in a denim jacket with no backpack, and pose both men mid-stride. Turn the buses into blue and white minibuses with blank destination signs and no plate lettering, and soften the crowd into loose shapes.
